description: Backend viral detection engine: hashtag/keyword discovery via yt-dlp, virality scoring algorithm, and new API endpoints for trending video discovery
steps: Create backend/viral_detection.py with: (a) fetch_hashtag_videos(hashtag, limit=20) function that uses yt-dlp to scrape https://www.tiktok.com/tag/{hashtag} with --flat-playlist and -j flags, returning video metadata (id, url, creator, title, view_count, like_count, comment_count, share_count, duration, upload_date, thumbnail). Follow the same async subprocess pattern as pipeline.fetch_creator_videos(). (b) fetch_keyword_videos(keyword, limit=20) function using yt-dlp TikTok search URL pattern. (c) compute_virality_score(video_meta) function that calculates a 0-100 virality score based on: engagement_rate = (likes + comments + shares) / views, velocity = views / age_in_hours, recency_boost = exponential decay favoring videos < 48 hours old, raw_scale = log-scaled view count bonus. The formula should weight velocity highest (40%), engagement_rate (30%), recency (20%), raw_scale (10%). (d) rank_videos(videos_list) that scores and sorts videos descending by virality_score.

Update backend/niches_config.py to add a 'hashtags' list to each niche (e.g., fitness: ['fitness', 'workout', 'gymtok'], comedy: ['comedy', 'funny', 'skit'], etc.). Keep the existing 'creators' field intact.

Add new API endpoints in backend/server.py: (a) GET /api/niches/{niche_key}/trending - fetches videos from the niche's hashtags via viral_detection.fetch_hashtag_videos(), scores them with compute_virality_score(), caches results in a new 'trending_videos' MongoDB collection with a 2-hour TTL, returns sorted list with virality_score field included. (b) GET /api/trending/search?q={query}&limit=20 - uses fetch_keyword_videos() for ad-hoc keyword search, returns scored results. (c) Modify GET /api/niches/{niche_key}/videos to add a 'mode' query param (default='curated'): mode=curated returns existing behavior, mode=trending returns from trending_videos collection, mode=mixed returns both merged and re-ranked by virality_score.

Add virality_score field computation to existing curated video fetching in GET /api/niches/{niche_key}/videos so that even curated videos get a virality_score (computed from their metadata). Update the curated_videos collection documents to include virality_score.

Add unit tests in backend/test_viral_detection.py testing: (a) compute_virality_score with known inputs produces expected score ranges, (b) rank_videos correctly orders videos, (c) edge cases (zero views, very old videos, missing fields).
acceptance_criteria: backend/viral_detection.py exists with fetch_hashtag_videos, fetch_keyword_videos, compute_virality_score, and rank_videos functions
niches_config.py has 'hashtags' key on every niche entry
GET /api/niches/{niche_key}/trending endpoint exists and returns videos with virality_score field
GET /api/trending/search endpoint exists and accepts q parameter
GET /api/niches/{niche_key}/videos accepts mode parameter with curated/trending/mixed options
All curated videos include a virality_score field in API responses
python -m pytest backend/test_viral_detection.py passes with all tests green
